interest: Nisei returning to America urged to use U.S. passports.
overview: Cross-reference, August 12, 1932: American-born Japanese should be discouraged from using Japanese birth records instead of U.S. passports.

subfiles.about: A cross-reference sheet recording policy to discourage American-born Japanese from using Japanese birth records in lieu of American passports when returning to the United States.
